name: innkeeper
desc: FRAMING: close half-body portrait cropped at the waist, head and shoulders filling most of the frame — not a full-length figure. A village innkeeper in her fifties with a shrewd welcoming neutral expression: broad face, strong arms, greying auburn hair twisted up and skewered with a wooden pin, a permanent slight amusement about the eyes. She wears a warm brick-red overdress with the sleeves buttoned back, a long linen apron tied twice round, a bunch of iron keys and a bottle-opener on a ring at her waist, and carries a stack of clean pewter cups against her hip. She has heard it all and poured through most of it.
